key_icons: Each digit has a small diamond to its right (white in the left column, half white and half grey in the middle column, grey with a white outline in the right column) and its small letters printed under the digit and diamond, on a black keypad. The 1 key shows a small envelope and voicemail icon under it; the * key shows 'a/A' under it; the 0 key shows '+' under it; the # key shows a small space symbol and a silent (crossed note) symbol under it.
